default.groupingBasis: Curated navigation hierarchy aligned at major clade level; it is not a phylogenetic hypothesis.
default.rangeBasis: First and last appearances are rounded display ranges assembled for the atlas and remain sensitive to sampling and taxonomy.
default.conflicts: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

life.groupingBasis: Root-level navigation scaffold spanning major living and fossil groups.
life.conflicts: The displayed 3.7 Ga boundary represents sampled biosignature evidence, not a resolved date for the origin of life or LUCA.

mammalia.groupingBasis: Major mammal groups are simplified to keep the atlas navigable.
mammalia.conflicts: Stem/crown definitions and divergence estimates vary among morphological and molecular analyses.

dinosauria.groupingBasis: Major dinosaur groups are represented as a compact navigation hierarchy.
dinosauria.conflicts: Alternative hypotheses for early dinosaur relationships are not resolved by this display.

perissodactyla.groupingBasis: Order-level navigation synthesis; the positions of several extinct early lineages remain analysis-dependent.
perissodactyla.conflicts: The displayed branching order is intentionally non-exhaustive and must not be read as a fully resolved binary consensus tree.
